assumptions.choice: Discretized indicators into standard bins: SMA (1 if Close > SMA, 0 otherwise), RSI (0 if <30, 2 if >70, 1 otherwise), MACD (1 if macd > signal, 0 otherwise), Bollinger Bands (0 if < lower band, 2 if > upper band, 1 otherwise).
assumptions.reason: The spec requires discretizing four indicators into discrete states but leaves explicit quantization thresholds unstated.

assumptions.choice: BUY signal maps to bullish state confluence (SMA=1, MACD=1, RSI!=2, BB!=2); SELL signal maps to bearish state confluence (SMA=0, MACD=0, RSI!=0, BB!=0); Exit signals trigger when trend/momentum states break.
assumptions.reason: The specification states that entry/exit decisions are derived from identified states without specifying the pre-computed policy table.

assumptions.choice: Placed Stop and Limit orders upon position entry completion based on actual executed fill price (2% SL, 4% TP).
assumptions.reason: The specification requires 2% stop-loss and 4% take-profit relative to the entry price.
